articles.title: An Evening with Manchester United Treble Winners at Middleton Arena
articles.excerpt: Football fans can meet Manchester United legends Andy Cole, Denis Irwin, and David May at Middleton Arena on October 23, 2026, for a night of stories and insights from their treble-winning season.
articles.content_html:
Football fans will have the opportunity to relive the glory days of Manchester United's treble-winning season at Middleton Arena on October 23, 2026. The event, titled 'An Evening With The Treble Winners', will feature three key figures from the record-breaking 1998-99 squad: Andy Cole, Denis Irwin, and David May.

Hosted by Alan Keegan, the voice of Old Trafford, the evening promises to be filled with anecdotes and insights from the players who played pivotal roles in Sir Alex Ferguson's successful campaign, which included victories in the Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League.

Middleton Arena described the event as a unique chance to hear from football icons, stating, "Three icons. One night. A lifetime of Old Trafford glory in the spotlight." Fans can expect to hear about title-winning moments and behind-the-scenes stories that shaped one of football's greatest eras.

Tickets for the event are expected to be in high demand, and those interested are encouraged to secure their places early to avoid disappointment. Further details on ticket availability can be found on the Middleton Arena website.

articles.title: Northern Care Alliance NHS Trust Declares Critical Incident Ahead of Strikes
articles.excerpt: The Northern Care Alliance NHS Foundation Trust has declared a critical incident as over 350 staff prepare to strike at hospitals including Rochdale Infirmary, affecting scheduled procedures.
articles.content_html:
The Northern Care Alliance NHS Foundation Trust (NCA) has declared a critical incident in response to upcoming strikes by over 350 workers across several hospitals, including Rochdale Infirmary. The strikes are set to take place on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, as staff dispute pay related to covering shortages.

The declaration aims to secure additional support to maintain urgent surgical services, although some procedures will be postponed. The affected hospitals include Salford Royal Hospital, Royal Oldham Hospital, and Fairfield Hospital in Bury, alongside Rochdale Infirmary.

Unison, the union representing the workers, has expressed its willingness to negotiate with the trust, which previously experienced four strikes in June. The NCA has apologised for the disruption this may cause to patients, assuring them that those impacted by changes to their surgery, treatment, or appointments will be contacted directly.

Patients are advised not to call the hospitals to check on their appointments, as the trust will reach out to them with updates. The situation highlights ongoing challenges within the NHS regarding staffing and pay, particularly in the context of increasing demands on healthcare services.

articles.title: Two Women Arrested After Three-Year-Old Boy Falls from Window in Rochdale
articles.excerpt: A three-year-old boy is in critical condition after falling from a first-floor window in Spotland Tops, Rochdale. Two women, aged 19 and 20, have been arrested on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child.
articles.content_html:
BREAKING NEWS — LIVE

Live updates, newest first.

18:27, 23 August 2026

A three-year-old boy is in critical condition after falling from a first-floor window in Spotland Tops, Rochdale. Two women, aged 19 and 20, have been arrested on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child.

A three-year-old boy is currently in critical condition after falling from a first-floor window in Rochdale. Emergency services were called to Spotland Tops in the Cutgate area shortly after 4.15pm on Saturday, August 22.

The boy was taken to hospital following the incident, where he remains under medical care. An air ambulance was also deployed to the scene to assist with the emergency response.

In connection with the incident, Greater Manchester Police (GMP) have arrested two women, aged 19 and 20, on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child. The arrests took place at an address in Blackburn, Lancashire, on Sunday, August 23.

GMP stated that inquiries into the full circumstances surrounding the incident are ongoing. Further updates are expected as the investigation progresses.
